from pathlib import Path
import json
import re

source_path = Path('manuscript.md')
original = source_path.read_bytes()
evidence = json.loads(Path('evidence.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert evidence['design'] == 'randomized laboratory experiment'
assert evidence['value'] == 1.8 and evidence['units'] == 'ms'
assert evidence['ci95'] == [0.3, 3.3]
assert evidence['sample_size'] is None
assert evidence['citation'] == 'Lee et al., [year needed]'
match = re.search(rb'(?m)"'^# Target paragraph'"\\r?\\n(?:\\r?\\n)+(?P<paragraph>.*?)(?=\\r?\\n(?:\\r?\\n)+# Discussion)', original, re.DOTALL)
assert match, 'Target paragraph boundaries not found'
paragraph = ('In the randomized laboratory experiment, the intervention reduced response latency '
             'by 1.8 ms (95% CI, 0.3\\u20133.3 ms) in the measured task (Lee et al., [year needed]). '
             'The sample size was [sample size needed].').encode('utf-8')
revised = original[:match.start('paragraph')] + paragraph + original[match.end('paragraph'):]
output_path = Path('outputs/manuscript.md')
output_path.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
output_path.write_bytes(revised)
saved = output_path.read_bytes()
assert saved[:match.start('paragraph')] == original[:match.start('paragraph')]
assert saved[match.start('paragraph') + len(paragraph):] == original[match.end('paragraph'):]
assert source_path.read_bytes() == original
assert evidence['citation'].encode('utf-8') in saved
print('Saved outputs/manuscript.md; all content outside the target paragraph is byte-for-byte unchanged.')
print(paragraph.decode('utf-8'))
